article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 13 Historic Broadcasts Dated Across Amos 'n' Andy and Foy Willing
article-meta.kwd-group: Amos 'n' Andy, Charles Correll, Freeman Gosden, Robert Benchley, Foy Willing, Western Harmony, Original Filenames

sec.title: Batch 17 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 17 resolves 13 historical broadcast recordings across two enduring American radio traditions: Freeman Gosden and Charles Correll's landmark comedy series ***Amos 'n' Andy*** (including wartime Rinso-sponsored episodes featuring guest stars Robert Benchley and Frank Morgan, plus rare 1930 and 1949 audition master discs) and 1946 syndicated transcription discs of western vocal masters ***Foy Willing And The Riders Of The Purple Sage***.

sec.title: 1. *Amos 'n' Andy* — NBC Master Runs & Historic Discs Dated
sec.p: Created, written, and voiced by Freeman Gosden and Charles Correll:
sec.table: | Original Circulating Filename | Canonical Title | Verified Airdate | Broadcast Context | |---|---|---|---| | `Amos_Andy_Divorce_Inc.mp3` | **"Divorce Inc. (Guest: Robert Benchley)"** | **1944-01-28** | Comedian Robert Benchley guest stars in a hilarious legal dispute sketch. | | `Amos_Andy_With_Frank_Morgan.mp3` | **"Guest: Frank Morgan (Rinso Presentation)"** | **1944-02-18** | MGM star Frank Morgan exchanges comic banter with the Kingfish. | | `Amos_Andy_Andy_Gets_Married.mp3` | **"Andy Gets Married (Part 1)"** | **1944-10-13** | Andy prepares for matrimony amidst escalating misunderstandings. | | `Amos_Andy_Lawsuit_Against_Andy.mp3` | **"Lawsuit Against Andy (Rinso White Whistle)"** | **1944-11-17** | The famous 'Rinso White' whistle introduces an Andy courtroom predicament. | | `Amos_Andy_The_Broken_Clock.mp3` | **"The Broken Clock (Rinso Presentation)"** | **1944-12-08** | Kingfish attempts to repair an antique clock with disastrous results. | | `Amos_Andy_Promo_Billy_Murray.mp3` | **"Perfect Record 12597: Billy Murray & Walter Scanlon Amos 'n' Andy Promo"** | **1930-04-15** | Rare 1930 Brunswick/Perfect promotional record featuring Billy Murray. | | `Amos_Andy_NY_Auditions_Complete.mp3` | **"1949 CBS Television Network Auditions: Charles Correll & Freeman Gosden"** | **1949-06-10** | Historic behind-the-scenes recording of Correll and Gosden's network auditions. |

sec.title: 2. *Foy Willing And The Riders Of The Purple Sage* (1946 Master Discs)
sec.p: Syndicated 15-minute western music shows recorded at Universal Recorders in Hollywood:
sec.table: | Original Circulating Filename | Canonical Title | Verified Airdate | Western Harmony Selections | |---|---|---|---| | `Foy_Willing_Trail_Herding_Cowboy.mp3` | **"Trail Herding Cowboy"** | **1946-09-02** | Foy Willing and the Riders perform traditional trail ballads. | | `Foy_Willing_Out_On_Open_Range.mp3` | **"Out on the Open Range"** | **1946-09-04** | Accordion and four-part western harmonies on the open prairie. | | `Foy_Willing_Rainbow_Over_Range.mp3` | **"There's a Rainbow Over the Range"** | **1946-09-06** | Signature Republic Pictures song arrangement. | | `Foy_Willing_Ole_Texas_Trail.mp3` | **"Ridin' Down That Ole Texas Trail"** | **1946-09-09** | Upbeat guitar and vocal harmony western swing classic. | | `Foy_Willing_Until_Payday_Rolls.mp3` | **"Until Payday Rolls Around"** | **1946-09-11** | Comic cowboy payday ballad performed with fiddle accompaniment. | | `Foy_Willing_Sagebrush_Symphony.mp3` | **"Sagebrush Symphony"** | **1946-09-13** | Instrumental medley and harmony vocals of range favorites. |
